content: library(shiny) library(bslib) library(ggplot2) # ============================================================================== # 1. GENERATE REPRODUCIBLE MYSTERY DATASETS ON STARTUP # ============================================================================== set.seed(2026) # Mystery Dataset A: True = Normal(mu = 72, sigma^2 = 64), n = 250 data_mystery_1 <- rnorm(250, mean = 72, sd = sqrt(64)) # Mystery Dataset B: True = Gamma(alpha = 4.5, beta = 0.8 [scale]), n = 300 # Note: In R, scale = beta corresponds to rate = 1 / beta data_mystery_2 <- rgamma(300, shape = 4.5, scale = 0.8) # Mystery Dataset C: True = Beta(alpha = 2.5, beta = 6.0), n = 250 data_mystery_3 <- rbeta(250, shape1 = 2.5, shape2 = 6.0) # ============================================================================== # 2. UI HELPER: SLIDER PAIRED WITH NUMERIC INPUT BOX # ============================================================================== sliderAndBoxUI <- function(ns, id, label_html, min, max, value, step) { div( class = "mb-3", tags$label(class = "form-label fw-semibold mb-1", HTML(label_html)), div( class = "d-flex align-items-center gap-2", div( style = "flex: 1;", sliderInput(ns(id), label = NULL, min = min, max = max, value = value, step = step, width = "100%") ), div( style = "width: 95px; margin-bottom: 15px;", numericInput(ns(paste0(id, "_num")), label = NULL, value = value, min = min, max = max, step = step, width = "100%") ) ) ) } # ============================================================================== # 3. SHINY MODULE UI FOR EACH MYSTERY DATASET TAB # ============================================================================== mysteryTabUI <- function(id, tab_title, x_min, x_max, step_size, init_interval, var_min, var_max, var_step, var_init) { ns <- NS(id) nav_panel( title = tab_title, layout_sidebar( sidebar = sidebar( width = 390, # Step 1: Select Candidate Distribution h5("1. Select Candidate Distribution"), selectInput( ns("dist"), "Choose a distribution family:", choices = c( "Uniform (a, b)" = "unif", "Exponential (λ)" = "exp", "Gamma (α, β)" = "gamma", "Normal (μ, σ²)" = "norm", "Beta (α, β)" = "beta" ), selected = "unif" ), hr(), h5("2. Adjust Parameters to Match Density"), # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- # CONDITIONAL SLIDERS + NUMERIC BOXES & PARAMETER INTERPRETATIONS # ---------------------------------------------------------------------- # --- UNIFORM --- conditionalPanel( condition = sprintf("input['%s'] == 'unif'", ns("dist")), sliderAndBoxUI(ns, "unif_min", "Minimum (a):", min = x_min, max = x_max, value = x_min + 0.15 * (x_max - x_min), step = step_size), sliderAndBoxUI(ns, "unif_max", "Maximum (b):", min = x_min, max = x_max, value = x_min + 0.85 * (x_max - x_min), step = step_size), div( class = "alert alert-light border small mt-2 mb-0", tags$strong("Parameter Interpretation (Uniform):"), tags$ul( class = "mb-0 ps-3 mt-1", tags$li(HTML("Support: Bounded interval [a, b].")), tags$li(HTML("Minimum (a) & Maximum (b): Lower and upper boundary cutoffs. Every outcome between a and b has constant density, with zero density outside the bounds.")) ) ) ), # --- EXPONENTIAL --- conditionalPanel( condition = sprintf("input['%s'] == 'exp'", ns("dist")), sliderAndBoxUI(ns, "exp_rate", "Rate (λ):", min = 0.01, max = 5.0, value = 0.5, step = 0.01), div( class = "alert alert-light border small mt-2 mb-0", tags$strong("Parameter Interpretation (Exponential):"), tags$ul( class = "mb-0 ps-3 mt-1", tags$li(HTML("Support: [0, ∞) — strictly positive, with its peak (mode) always at x = 0.")), tags$li(HTML("Rate (λ): Average number of events per unit of time or space. Increasing λ pulls the density steeply toward 0 (shorter wait times); decreasing λ stretches the right tail out.")) ) ) ), # --- GAMMA (Scale Parameterization: beta = scale = 1 / rate in R) --- conditionalPanel( condition = sprintf("input['%s'] == 'gamma'", ns("dist")), sliderAndBoxUI(ns, "gamma_shape", "Shape (α):", min = 0.5, max = 20.0, value = 2.0, step = 0.1), sliderAndBoxUI(ns, "gamma_scale", "Scale (β):", min = 0.05, max = 5.0, value = 1.5, step = 0.05), div( class = "alert alert-light border small mt-2 mb-0", tags$strong("Parameter Interpretation (Gamma):"), tags$ul( class = "mb-0 ps-3 mt-1", tags$li(HTML("Support: (0, ∞) — models positive, right-skewed continuous quantities.")), tags$li(HTML("Shape (α): Governs skewness and peakedness. When α ≤ 1, the density decreases from 0; when α > 1, it forms an interior peak that becomes more symmetric as α grows.")), tags$li(HTML("Scale (β): Stretches or compresses the distribution horizontally (note: R's default rate argument is 1/β, or scale = β). Increasing β stretches the distribution to the right and lowers the peak; decreasing β compresses it toward 0.")) ) ) ), # --- NORMAL (Parameterized by Mean mu and Variance sigma^2) --- conditionalPanel( condition = sprintf("input['%s'] == 'norm'", ns("dist")), sliderAndBoxUI(ns, "norm_mean", "Mean (μ):", min = x_min, max = x_max, value = round((x_min + x_max) / 2, 2), step = step_size), sliderAndBoxUI(ns, "norm_var", "Variance (σ2):", min = var_min, max = var_max, value = var_init, step = var_step), div( class = "alert alert-light border small mt-2 mb-0", tags$strong("Parameter Interpretation (Normal):"), tags$ul( class = "mb-0 ps-3 mt-1", tags$li(HTML("Support: (−∞, ∞) — symmetric bell-shaped curve.")), tags$li(HTML("Mean (μ): Location parameter marking the center of symmetry (peak). Changing μ shifts the entire curve left or right without changing its shape.")), tags$li(HTML("Variance (σ2): Spread parameter controlling horizontal dispersion around μ (note: R's dnorm/pnorm take standard deviation sd = √σ2). Larger σ2 flattens and widens the bell; smaller σ2 makes it tall and narrow.")) ) ) ), # --- BETA --- conditionalPanel( condition = sprintf("input['%s'] == 'beta'", ns("dist")), sliderAndBoxUI(ns, "beta_a", "Shape 1 (α):", min = 0.5, max = 15.0, value = 2.0, step = 0.1), sliderAndBoxUI(ns, "beta_b", "Shape 2 (β):", min = 0.5, max = 15.0, value = 2.0, step = 0.1), div( class = "alert alert-light border small mt-2 mb-0", tags$strong("Parameter Interpretation (Beta):"), tags$ul( class = "mb-0 ps-3 mt-1", tags$li(HTML("Support: Strictly bounded on [0, 1] — models proportions, rates, or probabilities.")), tags$li(HTML("Shape 1 (α) & Shape 2 (β): Control where density weight accumulates between 0 and 1.")), tags$li(HTML("When α < β, the peak pulls toward 0 (right-skewed). When α > β, the peak pulls toward 1 (left-skewed). When α = β, the curve is symmetric around 0.5. Increasing both parameters makes the peak narrower.")) ) ) ), hr(), # Step 3: Interval Bounds (Slider + Synced Numeric Boxes for a and b) h5("3. Empirical Probability Interval [a, b]"), p(class = "text-muted small mb-1", "Drag the slider or enter exact bounds to find the empirical proportion of observations in [a, b]."), sliderInput(ns("interval"), label = NULL, min = x_min, max = x_max, value = init_interval, step = step_size, width = "100%"), div( class = "d-flex gap-2 mt-1", div( style = "flex: 1;", numericInput(ns("int_a"), "Lower Bound (a):", value = init_interval[1], min = x_min, max = x_max, step = step_size, width = "100%") ), div( style = "flex: 1;", numericInput(ns("int_b"), "Upper Bound (b):", value = init_interval[2], min = x_min, max = x_max, step = step_size, width = "100%") ) ), hr(), downloadButton(ns("download_csv"), "Download Dataset (.csv)", class = "btn-sm btn-outline-primary w-100") ), # Main Panel Outputs (Empirical Only) layout_columns( col_widths = c(12, 6, 6), card( card_header("Empirical Density Histogram vs. Candidate Theoretical PDF"), plotOutput(ns("dist_plot"), height = "420px") ), card( card_header("Empirical Sample Summary Statistics"), tableOutput(ns("empirical_moments_table")) ), card( card_header("Empirical Interval Probability"), tableOutput(ns("empirical_probs_table")) ) ) ) ) } # ============================================================================== # 4. SHINY MODULE SERVER LOGIC # ============================================================================== mysteryTabServer <- function(id, dataset, x_limits, step_size, var_step, file_label) { moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) { # Helper to two-way sync a slider and its paired numeric input box # Preserves exact typed decimals even if they fall between slider steps syncPair <- function(slider_id, step_val) { num_id <- paste0(slider_id, "_num") # When slider moves -> update numeric box observeEvent(input[[slider_id]], { s_val <- input[[slider_id]] n_val <- input[[num_id]] if (is.na(n_val) || abs(s_val - n_val) > (step_val / 2 + 1e-9)) { updateNumericInput(session, num_id, value = s_val) } }, ignoreInit = TRUE) # When numeric box changes -> update slider position observeEvent(input[[num_id]], { n_val <- input[[num_id]] s_val <- input[[slider_id]] if (!is.null(n_val) && !is.na(n_val) && !isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(n_val), as.numeric(s_val)))) { updateSliderInput(session, slider_id, value = n_val) } }, ignoreInit = TRUE) } # Register sync for all parameter pairs syncPair("unif_min", step_size) syncPair("unif_max", step_size) syncPair("exp_rate", 0.01) syncPair("gamma_shape", 0.1) syncPair("gamma_scale", 0.05) syncPair("norm_mean", step_size) syncPair("norm_var", var_step) syncPair("beta_a", 0.1) syncPair("beta_b", 0.1) # Sync the 2-way Interval Slider [a, b] with Lower (int_a) and Upper (int_b) boxes observeEvent(input$interval, { s_int <- input$interval a_val <- input$int_a b_val <- input$int_b if (is.na(a_val) || abs(s_int[1] - a_val) > (step_size / 2 + 1e-9)) { updateNumericInput(session, "int_a", value = s_int[1]) } if (is.na(b_val) || abs(s_int[2] - b_val) > (step_size / 2 + 1e-9)) { updateNumericInput(session, "int_b", value = s_int[2]) } }, ignoreInit = TRUE) observeEvent(list(input$int_a, input$int_b), { a_val <- input$int_a b_val <- input$int_b s_int <- input$interval if (!is.null(a_val) && !is.na(a_val) && !is.null(b_val) && !is.na(b_val) && a_val <= b_val) { if (!isTRUE(all.equal(c(as.numeric(a_val), as.numeric(b_val)), as.numeric(s_int)))) { updateSliderInput(session, "interval", value = c(a_val, b_val)) } } }, ignoreInit = TRUE) # Helper to safely read the active numeric value (falling back to slider if box is temporarily blank) getParam <- function(slider_id) { n_val <- input[[paste0(slider_id, "_num")]] if (!is.null(n_val) && !is.na(n_val)) return(as.numeric(n_val)) as.numeric(input[[slider_id]]) } getInterval <- reactive({ a_val <- if (!is.null(input$int_a) && !is.na(input$int_a)) as.numeric(input$int_a) else input$interval[1] b_val <- if (!is.null(input$int_b) && !is.na(input$int_b)) as.numeric(input$int_b) else input$interval[2] validate(need(a_val <= b_val, "Lower bound (a) must be less than or equal to Upper bound (b).")) c(a_val, b_val) }) # Compute candidate PDF curve for plotting ONLY curve_info <- reactive({ dist <- input$dist x_grid <- seq(x_limits[1], x_limits[2], length.out = 600) if (dist == "unif") { u_min <- getParam("unif_min") u_max <- getParam("unif_max") validate(need(u_min < u_max, "For Uniform(a, b), Minimum (a) must be strictly less than Maximum (b).")) y_grid <- dunif(x_grid, min = u_min, max = u_max) label_str <- sprintf("Uniform(a = %g, b = %g)", u_min, u_max) } else if (dist == "exp") { rate <- getParam("exp_rate") validate(need(rate > 0, "Rate (λ) must be strictly positive.")) y_grid <- dexp(x_grid, rate = rate) label_str <- sprintf("Exponential(λ = %g)", rate) } else if (dist == "gamma") { sh <- getParam("gamma_shape") sc <- getParam("gamma_scale") validate(need(sh > 0 && sc > 0, "Shape (α) and Scale (β) must be strictly positive.")) # Using scale = beta (equivalent to rate = 1 / beta in R) y_grid <- dgamma(x_grid, shape = sh, scale = sc) label_str <- sprintf("Gamma(α = %g, β = %g)", sh, sc) } else if (dist == "norm") { mu <- getParam("norm_mean") var_val <- getParam("norm_var") validate(need(var_val > 0, "Variance (σ²) must be strictly positive.")) y_grid <- dnorm(x_grid, mean = mu, sd = sqrt(var_val)) label_str <- sprintf("Normal(μ = %g, σ² = %g)", mu, var_val) } else if (dist == "beta") { s1 <- getParam("beta_a") s2 <- getParam("beta_b") validate(need(s1 > 0 && s2 > 0, "Shape parameters (α, β) must be strictly positive.")) y_grid <- dbeta(x_grid, shape1 = s1, shape2 = s2) label_str <- sprintf("Beta(α = %g, β = %g)", s1, s2) } # Avoid infinite spikes at boundaries when shape < 1 y_grid[!is.finite(y_grid)] <- NA list( curve_df = data.frame(x = x_grid, y = y_grid), label_str = label_str ) }) # Render Plot (Fixed at 25 histogram bins) output$dist_plot <- renderPlot({ info <- curve_info() int_bounds <- getInterval() a <- int_bounds[1] b <- int_bounds[2] # Fixed 25 bins h <- hist(dataset, breaks = seq(x_limits[1], x_limits[2], length.out = 26), plot = FALSE) hist_df <- data.frame( xmin = h$breaks[-length(h$breaks)], xmax = h$breaks[-1], mids = h$mids, density = h$density ) hist_df$in_interval <- ifelse(hist_df$mids >= a & hist_df$mids <= b, "Inside [a, b]", "Outside") ggplot() + # Empirical Histogram Bars geom_rect( data = hist_df, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = density, fill = in_interval), color = "white", alpha = 0.7 ) + # Candidate Theoretical PDF Curve geom_line( data = info$curve_df, aes(x = x, y = y), color = "#d95f02", linewidth = 1.4, na.rm = TRUE ) + # Interval Boundary Lines geom_vline(xintercept = c(a, b), linetype = "dashed", color = "#1b9e77", linewidth = 1.0) + scale_fill_manual( name = "Empirical Histogram Bins", values = c("Inside [a, b]" = "#7570b3", "Outside" = "#cbd5e1") ) + labs( x = "Observed Value (x)", y = "Density f(x)", title = paste("Candidate Overlay:", info$label_str), subtitle = sprintf("Interval Bounds: [%g, %g] | Orange curve = Your candidate density", a, b) ) + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + theme( legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank() ) }) # Render Empirical Sample Moments ONLY output$empirical_moments_table <- renderTable({ data.frame( `Sample Statistic` = c( "Sample Size (n)", "Empirical Mean (x̄)", "Empirical Variance (s²)", "Empirical Std. Dev. (s)" ), `Observed Value` = c( sprintf("%d", length(dataset)), sprintf("%.4f", mean(dataset)), sprintf("%.4f", var(dataset)), sprintf("%.4f", sd(dataset)) ), check.names = FALSE ) }, width = "100%") # Render Empirical Interval Probability ONLY output$empirical_probs_table <- renderTable({ int_bounds <- getInterval() a <- int_bounds[1] b <- int_bounds[2] count_in <- sum(dataset >= a & dataset <= b) n_total <- length(dataset) emp_prob <- count_in / n_total data.frame( `Empirical Metric` = c( "Selected Interval [a, b]", "Observations in [a, b]", "Empirical Probability P̂(a ≤ X ≤ b)" ), `Value` = c( sprintf("[%g, %g]", a, b), sprintf("%d out of %d", count_in, n_total), sprintf("%.4f", emp_prob) ), check.names = FALSE ) }, width = "100%") # CSV Download Handler output$download_csv <- downloadHandler( filename = function() { paste0(file_label, ".csv") }, content = function(file) { write.csv(data.frame(x = dataset), file, row.names = FALSE) } ) }) } # ============================================================================== # 5. MAIN UI & SERVER INITIALIZATION # ============================================================================== ui <- page_navbar( title = "STAT 3110: Homework 7", theme = bs_theme(version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly"), mysteryTabUI( id = "tab1", tab_title = "Problem 3: Mystery Dataset A", x_min = 35, x_max = 110, step_size = 0.5, init_interval = c(65, 80), var_min = 1, var_max = 150, var_step = 1, var_init = 25 ), mysteryTabUI( id = "tab2", tab_title = "Problem 4: Mystery Dataset B", x_min = 0, x_max = 15, step_size = 0.1, init_interval = c(2.0, 5.0), var_min = 0.1, var_max = 25, var_step = 0.1, var_init = 4 ), mysteryTabUI( id = "tab3", tab_title = "Problem 5: Mystery Dataset C", x_min = 0, x_max = 1, step_size = 0.01, init_interval = c(0.2, 0.5), var_min = 0.005, var_max = 0.25, var_step = 0.005, var_init = 0.05 ) ) server <- function(input, output, session) { mysteryTabServer("tab1", dataset = data_mystery_1, x_limits = c(35, 110), step_size = 0.5, var_step = 1, file_label = "mystery_dataset_A") mysteryTabServer("tab2", dataset = data_mystery_2, x_limits = c(0, 15), step_size = 0.1, var_step = 0.1, file_label = "mystery_dataset_B") mysteryTabServer("tab3", dataset = data_mystery_3, x_limits = c(0, 1), step_size = 0.01, var_step = 0.005, file_label = "mystery_dataset_C") } shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
